proof_scope: The voice barge-in path for the conversational walkthrough: the RealtimeSTT listener transcribes real speech on the GPU and emits a HEARD utterance (the barge-in signal), and the walkthrough driver's --voice mode launches that listener and turns each spoken utterance into the next command (so 'Continue.' advances the walk). Real audio through the real recorder on the GPU; the driver-wiring case is capability-gated on a live VS Code bridge. Guards the regression where start_voice_listener() was defined but never wired into the loop.

claims.proves: barge_in_listener.py transcribes a real spoken wav through the real RealtimeSTT recorder on cuda and prints 'HEARD: <text>' while touching the stop flag; it fails closed when the audio is missing; and vscode_walkthrough.py --voice launches the listener and consumes each HEARD utterance as a spoken command (spoken 'Continue.' advances past a stop), normalizing STT punctuation/case
claims.does_not_prove: live microphone voice-activity timing (the mid-speech VAD barge-in is exercised live, not here), the correctness of an /ask answer, or that the host live-evidence venv can drive the recorder (its torch is cu130; the recorder runs in the cu128 container)

cases.name: listener-transcribes-real-audio-on-gpu
cases.description: Feed a real spoken wav ('continue') through barge_in_listener.py in the GPU container; it must transcribe on cuda and emit the HEARD barge-in line.
command: set -uo pipefail; SKILL="$(cd .. && pwd)"; docker run --rm --gpus all -v "$SKILL/scripts":/dbg:ro -v "$SKILL/scenarios/voice":/audio:ro -e DEBUGGER_STT_WAV=/audio/say-continue.wav --entrypoint python3 live-evidence-realtimestt-gpu:local /dbg/barge_in_listener.py /tmp/embry-stop.flag

cases.name: listener-fails-closed-on-missing-audio
cases.description: With DEBUGGER_STT_WAV pointing at a file that does not exist, the listener fails closed (BARGE-IN-UNAVAILABLE, exit 3) before loading any model, rather than hanging or passing blind.

cases.name: voice-wiring-advances-on-spoken-continue
cases.description: vscode_walkthrough.py --voice launches the real listener (transcribing the spoken wav in the GPU container) and consumes each spoken 'Continue.' as the next command, advancing through both stops to completion.
command: set -uo pipefail; export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="${UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT:-/mnt/storage12tb/skills/debugger/.venv}"; export UV_LINK_MODE=copy; SKILL="$(cd .. && pwd)"; WS="${DEBUGGER_VSCODE_WORKSPACE:-}"; if [ -z "$WS" ]; then WS="$(mktemp -d)"; cp ../scenarios/variable_state/*.py "$WS/"; fi; export DEBUGGER_STT_CMD="docker run --rm --gpus all -v $SKILL/scripts:/dbg:ro -v $SKILL/scenarios/voice:/audio:ro -e DEBUGGER_STT_WAV=/audio/say-continue.wav -e DEBUGGER_STT_WAV_LOOP=1 --entrypoint python3 live-evidence-realtimestt-gpu:local /dbg/barge_in_listener.py /tmp/embry-stop.flag"; uv run --project .. python ../scripts/vscode_walkthrough.py --spec ../scenarios/variable_state/walkthrough.converse.json --workspace "$WS" --voice --wait-seconds 30
